packageRules.description: CI-only bumps must not version the published package. index.cjs maps chore(deps)! to major, so action and pre-commit updates have to carry the actions scope instead.

devDependencies never reach consumers, so updating one must never release. The literal prefix is needed because the shared preset's major rule sets commitMessagePrefix 'chore(deps)!: ', which a packageRule can only override, not unset; index.cjs maps 'chore(actions)' to release: false. The separate group keeps dev updates out of groups that also hold runtime dependencies (the preset's semantic-release group holds both semantic-release and @semantic-release/commit-analyzer here), whose PR title would otherwise decide the release for both.
pre-commit hook majors: the shared preset restores the 'chore(actions): ' prefix for github-actions majors only, so without this a hook major still arrives as 'chore(deps)!: ' and releases a major.

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10 needs conventional-changelog-writer 9, but semantic-release's release-notes-generator 14 ships writer 8: 10.0-10.3 render notes with only the version heading and 10.4 fails the release. Hold it below 10 until a stable release-notes-generator moves to writer 9; test/release-notes.test.mjs fails on a mismatch.
